items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Yes. Mercer became the band leader. And I got along pretty well with Mercer.

ctx.x: So was Mercer leading the band after ‘74?

Yes. Mercer became the band leader. And I got along pretty well with Mercer. You know Mercer was a very nice man. It was just, I couldn’t stay in the band because I couldn’t do all that traveling. I just had enough of traveling. Constant bus riding and traveling around all the time, I just had enough of it.
I wonder how people do that for years and years. I mean think of Harry Carney, some 30 years.
